caption: Fede Galizia. Still Life with Apples, Pears, Cucumbers, Figs, Plums, and a Melon (c. 1625-1630).
alt: A still-life painting on a dark ground: a woven basket heaped with pears and apples, a bowl of figs and plums, a cut melon showing its orange flesh, cucumbers and peaches on a wooden ledge.
bibliography: Galizia, Fede. Still Life with Apples, Pears, Cucumbers, Figs, Plums, and a Melon. c. 1625–1630.
